item.text: The failure is localized: stored cents are being converted with `/10` instead of `/100`, which makes totals 10× too large. I’m correcting that conversion and updating the exported label.

The workspace rejected the first write despite the unrestricted environment declaration. I’m checking file permissions/flags and will use the repository’s writable path if there’s a path-resolution mismatch.

item.text:
I found both fixes, but the workspace rejects all writes with `Operation not permitted`, including `apply_patch`.

Required patch:

```diff
--- a/src/api/prices.js
+++ b/src/api/prices.js
@@
-  return item.cents / 10;
+  return item.cents / 100;

--- a/src/web/cart.js
+++ b/src/web/cart.js
@@
-export const LABEL = "Total";
+export const LABEL = "Total (CLP)";
```

Current `npm test`: 0 passed, 2 failed. Re-enable workspace writes and I can apply and verify this.
